form.label: CCDC | Overall Monitoring
form.description: Monitor all available CCDC telemetry. Panels show only what has actually been indexed.

search.query: index=* | stats count dc(sourcetype) as sourcetypes latest(_time) as last_seen by host | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort host
index=* | timechart span=5m count by host limit=12

panel.title: Recent Windows Account and System Changes

search.query: index=* (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4722 OR EventCode=4724 OR EventCode=4725 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=4741 OR EventCode=4697 OR EventCode=7045 OR EventCode=1102 OR EventCode=104) | table _time host EventCode Account_Name Message | sort -_time | head 100
index=* ("Failed password" OR "Invalid user") | stats count by host,source | sort -count
index=* (sourcetype=pan* OR sourcetype=ccdc:pan_syslog OR sourcetype=ccdc:vyos_syslog) | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen by host,sourcetype | convert ctime(last_seen)
